detector.crossing_assert_definition: left/right traversal through the pedestrian forward region
detector.crossing_yield_core: all samples in the active event, including exit hysteresis
detector.crossing_yield_definition: rear left/right traversal behind the pedestrian or consistent resolved lateral side; robot speed is diagnostic only
detector.crossing_unclassified_definition: missing entry heading or fewer than two resolved core-side samples
detector.against_flow_sidestep_definition: persistent pedestrian-forward-cone approach, then same-side robot lateral motion of at least the sidestep threshold at a robust rear pass
